Sidecar.OfflineHint: Double-click scripts/start-wiretap.cmd in the Wiretap module folder. This tab will connect automatically once it's running.

ServerUrl.Name: Sidecar Server URL
ServerUrl.Hint: URL of the Wiretap agent sidecar (default http://127.0.0.1:31416).

TerminalTheme.Name: Terminal Theme
TerminalTheme.Hint: Color theme for the embedded terminal.

FontSize.Name: Terminal Font Size
FontSize.Hint: Font size (px) of the embedded terminal.

BackupFolder.Name: Backup folder
BackupFolder.Hint: Absolute path of the folder the sidecar writes document backups to. Empty uses .wiretap/backups in the module folder.

AllowMacroExecution.Name: Risk gate: run macros
AllowMacroExecution.Hint: Lets agents run macros and write the code a macro runs (its command, its type changed to script, or an Adventure's stored macros), and write region behaviors that run a script, in a scene or an Adventure. A macro is arbitrary code with GM authority and can call game.settings.set, so enabling this lets an agent change any gate; only enable it for agents you trust.

AllowUserWrites.Name: Risk gate: write users
AllowUserWrites.Hint: Lets agents create, update and delete User documents, roles included.

AllowSettingWrites.Name: Risk gate: write settings
AllowSettingWrites.Hint: Lets agents write Setting documents and world or user settings. Wiretap settings stay unwritable.

AllowFileUpload.Name: Risk gate: file upload
AllowFileUpload.Hint: Lets agents send base64 data in file-path fields and use the file upload tool.

AllowOwnershipWrites.Name: Risk gate: write ownership
AllowOwnershipWrites.Hint: Lets agents change the ownership of documents.

AllowCompendiumWrites.Name: Risk gate: write compendiums
AllowCompendiumWrites.Hint: Lets agents write compendium packs and the documents inside them.

AllowModuleConfigWrites.Name: Risk gate: write module configuration
AllowModuleConfigWrites.Hint: Lets agents write the module configuration, which enables and disables modules.

AllowDelete.Name: Risk gate: delete documents
AllowDelete.Hint: Lets agents delete documents, with their embedded documents, through delete_documents and the deletes of a batch. It is also needed to remove embedded documents any other way: an update that removes an embedded collection or document, and a replace_document whose data leaves out embedded documents that exist (that replace also needs the replace gate). A deletion cannot be undone. Previews (dry runs) work without this gate.

AllowReplace.Name: Risk gate: replace documents
AllowReplace.Hint: Lets agents replace whole documents through replace_document, and replace an embedded collection in an update. Fields the new data leaves out reset to their defaults. Embedded documents it leaves out are deleted, which also needs the delete gate. Previews (dry runs) work without this gate.

AllowPackDeletion.Name: Risk gate: delete compendium packs
AllowPackDeletion.Hint: Lets agents delete an unlocked world compendium pack and every document in it for good, with delete_pack. Previews (dry runs) work without this gate.

AllowBackupAnyFolder.Name: Allow backups in any folder
AllowBackupAnyFolder.Hint: Lets agents write, list, restore and delete backup files in a folder other than the default (.wiretap/backups in the module folder) or the Backup folder setting.

AllowAgentScripts.Name: Risk gate: agent scripts
AllowAgentScripts.Hint: Lets agents save, disable and run scripts. A script is arbitrary code with GM authority and can call game.settings.set, so enabling this lets an agent change any gate; only enable it for agents you trust.

AllowedPluginModules.Name: Risk gate: plugin modules
AllowedPluginModules.Hint: Comma-separated ids of the modules whose plugin skills and scripts agents may use. A plugin script is arbitrary code with GM authority and can call game.settings.set, so listing a module lets an agent change any gate; list only modules you trust. Empty by default.
